hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: api
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: the url for the api calls

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
: "${datasetId:?datasetId is required}" api="${api:-http://dictionaryetl:8086/api}"
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" S3_KEY="dictionary/${datasetId}/vars.tsv" S3_URI="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_KEY}"
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; } need curl need aws need jq
cleanup() { rm -f "${assume_json:-}" 2>/dev/null || true unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
OUT_DIR="./${datasetId}" OUT_FILE="${OUT_DIR}/vars.tsv" mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
log "Fetching stigvars TSV from ${api} (ref=${datasetId})" curl --fail --show-error --silent \ "${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?ref=${datasetId}" \ > "$OUT_FILE"
if [[ ! -s "$OUT_FILE" ]]; then error "Downloaded vars.tsv is empty: $OUT_FILE" exit 1 fi log "Wrote ${OUT_FILE} (bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT_FILE"))"
log "Assuming role for S3 upload: ${ROLE_ARN}" assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")"
log "Uploading ${OUT_FILE} -> ${S3_URI}" aws s3 cp "$OUT_FILE" "$S3_URI" --no-progress
log "Upload complete"
